stem: Which sentence from the selection shows that totem poles were important for teaching Tlingit history?

options.label: A
options.text: These totem poles were read again and again like a library of wooden stories.

options.label: B
options.text: At last, the tree is ready for the master carver chosen by the tribe.

options.label: C
options.text: Animals with beaver tails, whales, wolves, and birds with oversized beaks are chiseled into the soft wood.

options.label: D
options.text: Long ago, artists mixed salmon eggs with minerals like hematite, graphite, and copper to make bright-colored paints for the poles.
